title: Release v1.37.0 (installer setup questions)
summary: NOT SUBMITTED ON THE LIVE CHAIN FOR v1.37.0. This release asks the operator for a validator name, a domain and an uploads policy during install, and stops a domain from overwriting a chosen name. Every change is in the host installer and in startup config rendering: no consensus state, no transaction execution, no query semantics. A v1.37.0 upgrade handler is registered, as earlier minor releases did, so scripts/test_upgrade.sh can rehearse the real halt-and-swap path against this plan name locally. Because nodes on v1.36.8 and v1.37.0 compute identical results from identical blocks, no halt is proposed on the live chain.
